selectedStackProfiles.precedenceNote: Repository unittest, pip, standard-library, and layout conventions override conflicting profile defaults until an approved modernization decision exists.
Repository content, schema, source-quality, and guide-quality policies are authoritative.

cloudProfile.reason: No owned cloud workload or infrastructure-as-code was found; cloud certification subject matter is content, not deployment evidence.

precedence.conflictRule: Higher-priority source wins; non-conflicting controls remain cumulative.
precedence.equalPriorityRule: Require explicit ADR approval before enforcement.

proposedIntents.intent: Retain public-source-only content, explicit AI disclosure, official-blueprint authority, volatile-claim labels, source promotion gates, and separation of AI versus human review.
Keep catalogs schema-backed and require stable identifiers, chronology, referential integrity, and explicit duplicate detection before publishing or reporting aggregates.
Move provider registration and cohesive validation domains behind stable interfaces without changing current command behavior, data contracts, or fail-closed semantics.
Use one governed validation definition for pull-request checks and Pages deployment while preserving the current four validation stages.
Expand risk-ranked AI audit and freshness coverage, retain independent dispositions, and define a bounded human-review sample without converting coverage counts into quality scores.
Retain dated manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, responsive, contrast, print, and reduced-motion evidence for representative published pages.
Retain deterministic dependencies while adding a reviewed update path for Python packages and a documented GitHub Action reference policy.

explicitNonGoals: Do not replace unittest with pytest merely to match the accelerator default.
Do not introduce Ruff, Black, a type checker, a package manager, a lockfile, containers, IaC, or cloud services without a separate evidence-based decision.
Do not rewrite guides, schemas, catalog semantics, provider adapters, or delivery workflows during discovery.
Do not copy accelerator prompts, skills, templates, configuration, or assistant wiring into the target.
Do not create backlog candidates, specifications, tickets, or implementation tasks from this intent artifact.
